inlines.v: ROAM, verb intransitive [If m is radical, this word seems to be connected with ramble, Latin ramus.] To wander; to ramble; to rove; to walk or move about from place to place without any certain purpose or direction. The wolf and the savage roam in the forest. Daphne roaming through a thorny wood. ROAM, verb transitive To range; to wander over; as, to roam the woods; but the phrase is elliptical.
